lead.event: IHSG falls below 5,000 for the first time since the pandemic era
lead.headline: IHSG falls below 5,000 for first time since pandemic era, closes at 4,985
lead.blurb: The index fell 108.06 points, or 2.2%, on Friday, after trading between 4,979 and 5,116. Continued foreign outflows included a Rp1.52 trillion net sell in the previous session. Panin Sekuritas maintained a cautious bias, warning that further weakness could put support at 4,270-4,440. It cited high oil prices pressuring the rupiah and possible spillover into bonds as SROs and OJK work to address MSCI reclassification concerns.

market_structure_policy.event: Bank Indonesia cuts banks' reserve requirements by two percentage points
market_structure_policy.headline: Bank Indonesia cuts banks' reserve requirements by 2 percentage points
market_structure_policy.blurb: BI Deputy Governor Destry Damayanti said the cut addresses uneven liquidity across banks. Conventional banks' ratio falls from 9% to 8% on 1 November and 7% on 1 December, while Islamic banks and units move from 7.5% to 6.5% and then 5.5%; the first stage releases around Rp80 trillion, with the second tied to adjustments to the Macroprudential Liquidity Incentive Policy.

earnings_guidance.event: Energi Mega Persada shares hit auto-reject limits for three consecutive sessions
earnings_guidance.headline: ENRG hits lower price limit for three consecutive sessions
earnings_guidance.blurb: Energi Mega Persada was locked at Rp665 from 27 to 29 October. Net sales for the period ended 30 September rose to USD426.06 million from USD361.38 million a year earlier. The company plans to complete its USD200 million acquisition of HighPeak Energy by year-end.

earnings_guidance.event: GoTo reports Q3 profit and raises its 2026 EBITDA target
earnings_guidance.headline: GOTO reports Q3 profit and raises 2026 adjusted group EBITDA target to Rp3.5–3.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Nine-month profit attributable to parent owners reached Rp1.16 trillion, reversing a Rp775.55 billion loss a year earlier. The revised target, up from Rp3.2–3.4 trillion, reflects fintech outperformance centered on GoPay and renewed growth in on-demand services.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

earnings_guidance.event: BNI reports nine-month 2026 profit growth as shares rebound
earnings_guidance.headline: BBNI reports 6.6% nine-month profit growth as shares rebound
earnings_guidance.blurb: BNI reported nine-month net profit of Rp16.1 trillion, up 6.6% annually, as loans grew 22.2% to Rp992.5 trillion. Shares rebounded to Rp3,240 at the 29 October close from around Rp2,800 in mid-October. Mirae Asset analyst Nafan Aji sees fundamentals supporting a re-rating but flags foreign flows and MSCI policy.

earnings_guidance.event: Chandra Asri Pacific reports lower nine-month profit
earnings_guidance.headline: TPIA reports nine-month profit down 78.4% to US$279.81 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: Chandra Asri's revenue rose 60.5% year-on-year to US$8.19 billion, while raw material and production expenses increased 40.77% to US$7.23 billion. The year-earlier period included a US$1.81 billion bargain purchase gain that was absent in the first nine months of 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GoTo reports share buybacks and plans to cancel treasury shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GOTO reports Rp985 billion buyback and plans to cancel 32 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: GoTo’s buyback accelerated after the IDX removed the Rp50 minimum share price on 28 September. By 29 October, it had spent Rp985 billion repurchasing 36 billion shares. The approved cancellation is expected within two to three months after regulatory processes are completed and is intended to reduce outstanding shares and raise existing shareholders’ ownership.
